title: 第1章 一百二十次第2章 剑匣
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 落云城，孙家
东升的旭日才露出半个头，林间的树叶上还有着明显的水珠，但是后山的密林却响起了一阵阵挥剑声。
只见一名十六岁的少年手持一柄三寸长的木剑，正在林中努力练剑，少年剑眉星目，虽然身着简朴，但却神色严肃，沉醉于练剑之中。
他所练的剑法仅仅只是基础剑法，虽然招式平淡，但基础剑法中的每一招每一式都被少年完美的演练出来。
这少年名叫孙冰，是孙家的一名弟子。
劈剑、刺剑、撩剑、扫剑……一招招看似简单的基础剑法，在孙冰的手中仿佛焕发起了青春，尤其是手中那一柄木剑，从最初的木色已经蜕变成了纯黑色，透着浓重的历史气息，想必已经使用很长时间了。
不过一套剑法演练完毕，孙冰面色瞬间苍白，同时双眼流出一丝不甘：“身体素质果然还是跟不上，仅仅一套基础剑法就让我受不了了，苍天不公啊。”
话音刚落，原先不甘的神色逐渐隐去，望了望已经高升的朝阳，孙冰计算了一下时间，轻声道：“又到了领取月俸的时候了，趁早去，希望今天运气好点吧。”
说完便将木剑贴身收拾好，然后转身就朝着孙家走去。
孙家乃是落云镇三大世家之一，起源于两百年前，当初是靠药材起家，最后先祖机缘巧合之下修炼了，然后就创造了一方世家。可能听起来没有什么，但是落云镇整整十万人口，方圆百里除了其余两大世家，再也没有别的敌手，堪称是土皇帝。
后山距离孙家并不算远，不多时孙冰就已经走到了孙家的大门口，整个大门都是用珍贵的紫檀木制作而成，寻常百姓即便获得一块，也能衣食无忧数年之久。
门上的把手则是由黄金制作而成的狰狞妖兽，把手旁分别镶嵌着两颗名贵的夜明珠，洁白动人；而远远望去，镶满黄金的大门，在阳光的照耀下更是耀眼。
就单单一个大门，足以彰显出世家的威严与底蕴，这也就三大世家敢如此张扬，寻常人若是如此的话，哪怕家财万贯也不敌修士一道神通。
大门之后则是宽阔的庭院，小道的两旁还栽种着树木花草供人欣赏，只不过此刻的孙冰完全没有欣赏美景的心思，只想要快点领取自己的月俸，这样才能够进行修炼。
月俸是在一个偏远的账房由外围管事秦明发放，只不过往常异常安静的账房今天倒有点门庭若市的感觉，人虽然多，但丝毫不乱，每个人都秩序井然的排着队，虽然其中夹杂着些许轻微的交谈声，倒也无伤大雅。
只不过孙冰与他人完全不同，仿佛一个透明人一样，哪怕别人聊得再怎么开心，也与他没有丝毫关系，甚至他的身前身后都空着一个位置，没有任何一个人愿意接近他。
对此孙冰也毫不在意，眼观鼻鼻观口口观心，静静的等待，月俸可以算是家族弟子的一项福利了，即便你再怎么懒惰，凭借着家族发放的月俸也能保证自己的基础生活。
队伍的前进速度很快，管事基本看一眼人确认之后就会发放月俸，基本不会有丝毫耽搁，不多时就轮到了孙冰，正当他准备上前一步领取月俸的时候，一个人从大门处缓缓走来。
根本就没有要排队的意思，直接就跑到了孙冰的前面，然后淡淡道：“拿出来吧！”
这态度可以算是翘上天了，周围的交谈声也缓缓停下，可秦管事面对这样恶劣的态度，脸上不仅没有丝毫不满，甚至还满脸笑容：“这不是孙耀么？又来帮大少爷领取月俸啊，这是这个月的，你看看。”说完，足足给了孙耀两瓶淬体丹，同时还奉上了数十两银子。
只不过孙耀鼻孔都翘上天了，随手把月俸拿在手上，不说一句话转身就走，这让秦管事只能尴尬的笑着，周围不少人都面露笑意，只不过强行忍住了。
可即便孙耀态度无礼，秦管事也没有办法，因为孙耀的主子可是孙家的大少爷孙龙，此刻已经淬体八层，甚至即将突破淬体九层，堪称是孙家的第一天才，月俸这点小钱完全不被对方放在眼中，甚至可以说这就是给自己小厮的打赏。
秦管事对孙耀没什么办法，一肚子火憋在心里，不由得望向身后孙冰的面色就有些不善了，随手取一两银子往柜台上一放，懒洋洋的说到：“诺，这就是你的月俸了。”
望着柜台上仅仅一两银子，孙冰不由得死死咬住牙关，拳头握的紧紧的，同时心中暗暗记住：“这是第十年，第一百二十次。”
要知道孙家对于年青一代的月俸是每人每月十两银子，一瓶淬体丹，其中淬体丹更是大头，而秦管事给孙冰的只有其余人的十分之一。
别说一瓶淬体丹了，哪怕一枚都没有，这与之前的孙耀相比，更是天差地别，要知道孙耀仅仅只是别人的一个下人。
“啧啧，没有想到孙冰竟然还有脸留下来，竟然还有勇气来领取月俸，呵呵一个废物。”
content_en:
Luoyun City, Sun Family
The rising sun had only half of its head exposed, and there were still obvious drops of water on the leaves in the forest, but the sound of sword swings could be heard in the dense forest at the back of the mountain.
I saw a sixteen-year-old boy holding a three-inch long wooden sword and practicing his sword hard in the forest. The young man had sharp eyebrows and starry eyes. Although he was dressed simply, his expression was serious and he was intoxicated in sword practice.
The swordsmanship he practiced was only basic swordsmanship. Although the moves were mediocre, every move and move in the basic swordsmanship was perfectly practiced by the boy.
This young man's name is Sun Bing, and he is a disciple of the Sun family.
Splitting the sword, thrusting the sword, lifting the sword, sweeping the sword... the seemingly simple basic sword skills seemed to be rejuvenated in Sun Bing's hands, especially the wooden sword in his hand, which had transformed from the original wood color to pure black, exuding a strong historical atmosphere. It must have been used for a long time.
However, after practicing a set of sword skills, Sun Bing's face instantly turned pale, and at the same time, his eyes showed a trace of unwillingness: "My physical fitness is still not up to par. Just a set of basic sword skills makes me unbearable. God is unfair."
As soon as he finished speaking, the original unwilling look gradually faded away. Looking at the rising sun, Sun Bing calculated the time and said softly: "It's time to collect monthly salary again. Go as early as possible. I hope you will have better luck today."
After saying that, he put away the wooden sword close to his body, then turned around and walked towards Sun's house.
The Sun family is one of the three major aristocratic families in Luoyun Town. It originated two hundred years ago. It started out by relying on medicinal materials. Finally, its ancestors practiced medicine by chance, and then created a family. It may not sound like much, but Luoyun Town has a population of 100,000, and apart from the other two major families within a hundred miles, there is no other opponent. It can be called the emperor of the earth.
The back mountain is not far from the Sun family. Not long after, Sun Bing had already arrived at the door of the Sun family. The entire door was made of precious red sandalwood. Even if ordinary people got one piece, they could live without worries for several years.
The handle on the door is a ferocious monster made of gold. There are two precious luminous pearls inlaid next to the handle, which are white and moving. Looking from a distance, the door inlaid with gold is even more dazzling under the sunlight.
Just one gate is enough to show the majesty and heritage of the family. This is why the three major families dare to show off like this. If ordinary people are like this, even if they have a huge wealth, they will not be able to match the magical power of a monk.
Behind the gate is a wide courtyard, with trees and flowers planted on both sides of the path for people to enjoy. However, at this moment, Sun Bing has no intention of enjoying the beautiful scenery. He just wants to collect his monthly salary quickly so that he can practice.
The monthly salary was distributed in a remote accounting room by the peripheral steward Qin Ming. However, the usually quiet accounting room felt a bit crowded today. Although there were many people, it was not chaotic at all. Everyone lined up in an orderly manner. Although there were some slight conversations mixed in, it was not harmful.
It's just that Sun Bing is completely different from others, as if he is a transparent person. No matter how happy others chat, it has nothing to do with him. There is even an empty space in front of and behind him, and no one is willing to approach him.
Sun Bing didn't care about this. He watched his eyes, nose, mouth, and heart, and waited quietly. The monthly salary can be regarded as a benefit for the disciples of the family. No matter how lazy you are, you can guarantee your basic life with the monthly salary distributed by the family.
The team moved forward very quickly. The manager would basically give out the monthly salary after one glance at the person for confirmation. There would be no delay at all. Soon it was Sun Bing's turn. Just as he was about to step forward to receive the monthly salary, a man slowly walked from the gate.
There was no intention of queuing up, so he ran directly in front of Sun Bing and said calmly: "Take it out!"
This attitude was so outrageous that the surrounding conversations slowly stopped. However, in the face of such a bad attitude, Manager Qin not only showed no dissatisfaction on his face, but even smiled: "Isn't this Sun Yao? I'm here to help the eldest young master collect his monthly salary. This is for this month. Take a look." After saying that, he gave Sun Yao two bottles of body tempering pills and dozens of taels of silver.
It's just that Sun Yao's nostrils were raised to the sky, he casually took the monthly salary in his hand, turned around and left without saying a word, which made Manager Qin smile awkwardly. Many people around him were smiling, but they just suppressed it.
But even if Sun Yao was rude, Manager Qin had no choice, because Sun Yao's master was Sun Long, the eldest son of the Sun family. He had already reached the eighth level of Body Tempering and was about to break through to the ninth level. He was the number one genius of the Sun family. The small amount of monthly salary was not taken seriously by the other party at all. It could even be said that this was a reward for his servant.
Manager Qin had nothing to do with Sun Yao. He was simmering with anger in his heart. He couldn't help but look behind him and Sun Bing's expression turned a little unkind. He casually took a tael of silver and put it on the counter. He said lazily: "Nuo, this is your monthly salary."
Looking at only one tael of silver on the counter, Sun Bing couldn't help but grit his teeth and clenched his fists tightly, while secretly remembering in his heart: "This is the tenth year, the one hundred and twentieth time."
You must know that the Sun family's monthly salary for the younger generation is ten taels of silver per person per month and a bottle of Body Tempering Pills, of which the Body Tempering Pills cost a large amount. However, Manager Qin gave Sun Bing only one-tenth of what the others paid.
Not to mention a bottle of body tempering pill, not even one. Compared with the previous Sun Yao, this is completely different. You must know that Sun Yao is just a servant of others.
"Tsk, tsk, I didn't expect that Sun Bing would have the nerve to stay, and the courage to come and receive his monthly salary, hehe, he's such a loser."
